title: ACF awards $6M for testing predictive analytics in 10 child welfare jurisdictions
summary: New federal funding will aid child welfare agencies in testing out predictive analytics tools.

title: Pennsylvania boosted budget for cybersecurity, digital services
summary: New cybersecurity and digital services funding builds on the Shapiro administration's agenda of improving how citizens interact with government.

title: New York tech office signs agreement with IBM for AI, cloud services
summary: A recent agreement between IBM and New York state's tech office is expected to save taxpayers $6 million over the next three years.

title: Ohio launches first statewide data-sharing compact to standardize agency agreements
summary: Ohio launched its first statewide data-sharing compact to standardize agency agreements and guide the use of AI.

title: California launches teen council for emerging tech, digital wellness
summary: A new initiative in California will aim to give young people a larger role in shaping conversations and policy around technology.

summary: A new initiative at the National League of Cities will aim to help local governments find the soft spots in their organizations and computer networks.

summary: The Consortium for School Networking published a new resource aimed at helping schools navigate new rules on classroom technology use.

title: State chatbot laws could create regulatory patchwork, new report warns
summary: Researchers claimed inconsistent state definitions and requirements could make it harder for developers to comply, while diverting attention from safeguards that directly address documented risks to children.

summary: A recent audit found that decades-old systems threaten the corrections department's ability to manage its prisons safely.

title: New York boosts funding for water cybersecurity grants
